notice: The debit percentages and the decisions to decline are invented for this synthetic manual. The thresholds follow the public source named in each rule, except the edges a rule marks as this manual's own.

applies.words: A diagnosis of type 2 diabetes is on file. A raised HbA1c with no diagnosis is read in the prediabetes section instead.

measures.label: HbA1c
measures.meaning: Glycated haemoglobin: the share of haemoglobin carrying glucose, which reflects average blood glucose over about three months.
measures.conversion: A result in mmol/mol is multiplied by 0.0915 and 2.15 is added to give per cent: 53 mmol/mol is 7.0 %.

applies.words: A diagnosis of type 1 diabetes is on file, whatever the age at which it began.

measures.label: HbA1c
measures.meaning: Glycated haemoglobin: the share of haemoglobin carrying glucose, which reflects average blood glucose over about three months.
measures.conversion: A result in mmol/mol is multiplied by 0.0915 and 2.15 is added to give per cent: 53 mmol/mol is 7.0 %.

applies.words: A laboratory HbA1c is on file and no diagnosis of diabetes of either type has been made.

measures.label: HbA1c
measures.meaning: Glycated haemoglobin: the share of haemoglobin carrying glucose, which reflects average blood glucose over about three months.
measures.conversion: A result in mmol/mol is multiplied by 0.0915 and 2.15 is added to give per cent: 53 mmol/mol is 7.0 %.

threshold.words: HbA1c below 5.7 %

gaps.meaning: a normal reading; no rule and no debit

threshold.words: HbA1c of 6.5 % or more

gaps.meaning: the level that defines diabetes; ask whether the diagnosis has been made, and read the diabetes section once it has

applies.words: Every applicant: height and weight are on file for all of them.

measures.label: body mass index
measures.meaning: Weight in kilograms divided by the square of height in metres.
measures.conversion: From pounds and inches: weight in pounds times 703, divided by the square of height in inches.

threshold.words: body mass index from 18.5 to below 35.0 kg/m2

gaps.meaning: no rule; no debit for build in this range

applies.words: An LDL cholesterol result is on file, with or without a diagnosis or treatment.

measures.label: LDL cholesterol
measures.meaning: Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in a fasting blood sample, the fraction most closely tied to artery disease.
measures.conversion: A result in mmol/L is multiplied by 38.67 to give mg/dL: 4.14 mmol/L is 160 mg/dL.

threshold.words: LDL cholesterol below 160 mg/dL

gaps.meaning: no rule; no debit for LDL cholesterol

applies.words: A fasting triglyceride result is on file.

measures.label: fasting triglycerides
measures.meaning: The main blood fat, measured after a fast of at least eight hours.
measures.conversion: A result in mmol/L is multiplied by 88.57 to give mg/dL: 2.0 mmol/L is about 177 mg/dL.

threshold.words: fasting triglycerides below 175 mg/dL

gaps.meaning: no rule; no debit for triglycerides

applies.words: Gout has been diagnosed. A raised urate in someone who has never had an attack is not gout and meets no rule here.

measures.label: serum urate
measures.meaning: The level of uric acid in the blood; crystals form in joints when it stays high.
measures.conversion: A result in micromol/L is divided by 59.48 to give mg/dL: 357 micromol/L is 6.0 mg/dL.

applies.words: An underactive thyroid has been diagnosed, treated or not.

measures.label: TSH
measures.meaning: Thyroid-stimulating hormone; it rises when the thyroid gland makes too little hormone.

applies.words: Blood pressure readings from the last twelve months are on file, whether or not hypertension has been diagnosed or is treated.

measures.label: systolic blood pressure
measures.meaning: The higher of the two blood pressure numbers: the pressure while the heart contracts.
measures.conversion: A reading in kPa is multiplied by 7.5 to give mmHg.

measures.label: diastolic blood pressure
measures.meaning: The lower of the two blood pressure numbers: the pressure while the heart rests between beats.
measures.conversion: A reading in kPa is multiplied by 7.5 to give mmHg.

threshold.words: systolic blood pressure below 130 mmHg

gaps.meaning: no rule; normal or elevated pressure, or hypertension held at goal, carries no debit

threshold.words: diastolic blood pressure below 120 mmHg

gaps.meaning: no rule of its own; the systolic rules decide the rating

applies.words: A heart attack is recorded in the history.

measures.label: time since the heart attack
measures.meaning: Whole months from the date of the most recent heart attack to the date of the application.

applies.words: Heart failure has been diagnosed.

measures.label: left ventricular ejection fraction
measures.meaning: The share of the blood in the left ventricle that is pumped out with each beat, usually from an echocardiogram.

applies.words: Atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter has been recorded on an ECG.

measures.label: CHA2DS2-VASc score
measures.meaning: A stroke risk score for atrial fibrillation built from age, sex, heart failure, hypertension, diabetes, vascular disease and earlier stroke.

applies.words: Aortic stenosis has been reported on an echocardiogram.

measures.label: peak aortic jet velocity
measures.meaning: The fastest blood flow through the aortic valve on echocardiography; it rises as the valve narrows.

threshold.words: peak aortic jet velocity below 2.0 m/s

gaps.meaning: no rule; thickening of the valve without narrowing

applies.words: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy has been diagnosed by a cardiologist.

measures.label: maximum left ventricular wall thickness
measures.meaning: The thickest part of the wall of the heart's main pumping chamber, on echocardiogram or cardiac MRI.
measures.conversion: A thickness in cm is multiplied by ten to give mm.

threshold.words: maximum left ventricular wall thickness below 15 mm

gaps.meaning: below the diagnostic thickness; no rule; send to a person if the diagnosis is stated all the same

applies.words: An abdominal aortic aneurysm has been found on imaging.

measures.label: abdominal aortic diameter
measures.meaning: The widest outer diameter of the aorta in the abdomen on ultrasound or CT.
measures.conversion: A diameter in mm is divided by ten to give cm.

threshold.words: abdominal aortic diameter below 3.0 cm

gaps.meaning: no rule; not an aneurysm

applies.words: Peripheral artery disease has been diagnosed or an ankle-brachial index has been measured for leg symptoms.

measures.label: resting ankle-brachial index
measures.meaning: Systolic pressure at the ankle divided by systolic pressure in the arm; a low value means narrowed leg arteries.

threshold.words: resting ankle-brachial index above 0.90 and up to 1.40

gaps.meaning: no rule; a normal or borderline index

applies.words: Narrowing of a carotid artery has been reported on imaging.

measures.label: carotid artery stenosis
measures.meaning: How much of the internal carotid artery's width is lost to plaque, as reported on duplex ultrasound or angiography.

threshold.words: carotid artery stenosis below 50 %

gaps.meaning: no rule; mild narrowing

applies.words: A stroke is recorded in the history, with damage shown on brain imaging.

measures.label: NIHSS score at admission
measures.meaning: The National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale, from 0 to 42, scored when the patient reaches hospital; a higher score is a more severe stroke.

applies.words: A deep vein thrombosis or a pulmonary embolism is recorded in the history.

measures.label: time since the clot
measures.meaning: Whole months from the diagnosis of the most recent deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism to the date of the application.

applies.words: Every applicant: smoking status is recorded for all of them.

measures.label: smoking status
measures.meaning: Whether the applicant smokes cigarettes now, used to, or never has, as the survey definitions put it.

measures.label: lifetime smoking
measures.meaning: Packs of 20 cigarettes smoked a day multiplied by the number of years smoked.
measures.conversion: Cigarettes a day divided by 20, times the years smoked: 10 a day for 30 years is 15 pack-years.

threshold.words: smoking status: never smoked

gaps.meaning: no rule; fewer than 100 cigarettes in a lifetime

threshold.words: lifetime smoking below 20 pack-years

gaps.meaning: no rule for the lifetime total; the status rules still apply

applies.words: An AUDIT score recorded by a clinician is on file.

measures.label: AUDIT score
measures.meaning: The total, from 0 to 40, of the ten-question Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test.

threshold.words: AUDIT score below 8 points

gaps.meaning: no rule; the low-risk zone

applies.words: An opioid medicine has been prescribed for pain, other than cancer pain, for three months or longer.

measures.label: daily opioid dose
measures.meaning: The total of all opioid medicines taken in a day, converted to morphine milligram equivalents (MME).
measures.conversion: Multiply each medicine's daily milligrams by its factor and add the results: morphine 1, hydrocodone 1, oxycodone 1.5, hydromorphone 4, codeine 0.15, tramadol 0.1. A fentanyl patch counts 2.4 for each microgram an hour.

applies.words: Asthma has been diagnosed.

measures.label: FEV1
measures.meaning: The volume of air blown out in the first second of a forced breath, as a percentage of the value expected for age, height and sex.

applies.words: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, chronic bronchitis with obstruction or emphysema has been diagnosed.

measures.label: FEV1 after a bronchodilator
measures.meaning: FEV1 measured after an inhaled airway-opening medicine, so that only the fixed part of the obstruction is counted.

applies.words: Obstructive sleep apnoea has been diagnosed by a sleep study.

measures.label: apnoea-hypopnoea index
measures.meaning: The number of pauses and shallow breaths in each hour of sleep, from a sleep study done without treatment.

threshold.words: apnoea-hypopnoea index below 5 events per hour

gaps.meaning: no rule; not sleep apnoea

applies.words: Two eGFR results at least three months apart are on file.

measures.label: eGFR
measures.meaning: Estimated glomerular filtration rate: how much blood the kidneys clean each minute, worked out from serum creatinine.

threshold.words: eGFR of 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 or more

gaps.meaning: no rule of this section; albumin in the urine is read in its own section

applies.words: A laboratory urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio is on file.

measures.label: urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio
measures.meaning: Albumin in a urine sample relative to creatinine; a rise is the earliest sign of kidney damage.
measures.conversion: A ratio in mg/mmol is multiplied by 8.84 to give mg/g: 3.4 mg/mmol is 30 mg/g and 34 mg/mmol is 300 mg/g.

threshold.words: urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio below 30 mg/g

gaps.meaning: no rule; a normal ratio

applies.words: Hepatitis B surface antigen has been positive for more than six months.

measures.label: HBV DNA
measures.meaning: The amount of hepatitis B virus in the blood.
measures.conversion: A result in copies/mL is divided by 5 to give IU/mL, unless the laboratory report states its own factor.

applies.words: Hepatitis C virus RNA has been detected at any time.

measures.label: time with undetectable HCV RNA after the end of treatment
measures.meaning: Whole weeks from the last dose of antiviral treatment to the most recent test that found no hepatitis C virus.

applies.words: Fatty liver has been reported on imaging or diagnosed by a physician.

measures.label: FIB-4 index
measures.meaning: An estimate of liver scarring worked out from age, two liver enzymes and the platelet count.
measures.conversion: The index is age in years times AST, divided by the platelet count in thousands per microlitre times the square root of ALT.

applies.words: Cirrhosis has been diagnosed by biopsy, by a stiffness scan or by a liver specialist.

measures.label: MELD score
measures.meaning: Model for End-Stage Liver Disease: a score from bilirubin, creatinine and clotting time that predicts three-month survival in cirrhosis.

applies.words: Ulcerative colitis has been diagnosed at colonoscopy.

measures.label: faecal calprotectin
measures.meaning: A protein from white blood cells measured in a stool sample; it rises with inflammation of the bowel wall.
measures.conversion: A result in mg/kg is the same number in mcg/g.

applies.words: A full blood count from the last six months is on file.

measures.label: haemoglobin
measures.meaning: The oxygen-carrying protein of red blood cells, measured in a full blood count.
measures.conversion: A result in g/L is divided by ten to give g/dL.

threshold.words: haemoglobin of 11.0 g/dL or more

gaps.meaning: no rule; mild anaemia or none

applies.words: Haemophilia A or B has been diagnosed.

measures.label: clotting factor level
measures.meaning: The activity of factor VIII or factor IX in the blood without treatment; 100 IU/dL is the average of healthy people.
measures.conversion: A level given as a percentage of normal is the same number in IU/dL.

threshold.words: clotting factor level of 40 IU/dL or more

gaps.meaning: no rule; not haemophilia by factor level

applies.words: HIV infection has been diagnosed.

measures.label: CD4 count
measures.meaning: The number of CD4 lymphocytes in a cubic millimetre of blood, a measure of immune strength.
measures.conversion: A count in cells per microlitre is the same number in cells/mm3.

applies.words: Depression has been diagnosed or treated within the last five years.

measures.label: PHQ-9 score
measures.meaning: The total, from 0 to 27, of a nine-question self-report of depressive symptoms over two weeks.

applies.words: Epilepsy has been diagnosed.

measures.label: time since the last seizure
measures.meaning: Whole years from the most recent seizure of any kind to the date of the application.

applies.words: Rheumatoid arthritis has been diagnosed by a rheumatologist.

measures.label: DAS28
measures.meaning: Disease Activity Score over 28 joints, built from tender and swollen joint counts, a blood marker of inflammation and the patient's own rating.

applies.words: A bone density scan from the last three years is on file.

measures.label: bone density T-score
measures.meaning: Bone mineral density at the hip or spine compared with the average of healthy young adults, in standard deviations.

threshold.words: bone density T-score above -2.5 standard deviations

gaps.meaning: no rule; bone density that is normal or only reduced

applies.words: An invasive melanoma of the skin has been removed, with no spread to lymph nodes or beyond.

measures.label: tumour thickness
measures.meaning: The depth of a melanoma from the skin surface to its deepest cell, measured by the pathologist.

threshold.words: HbA1c below 7.0 %

rules.note: Control at the usual treatment goal.
